# Dōbutsu no Mori e+ PC/Android port v1.1.2

Version 1.1.2 of the port that runs [afe-decomp](https://github.com/cailet0422/afe-decomp) (the どうぶつの森 e+ decompilation) on PC and Android.

## Changes since v1.1.1

- **Chat while playing.** In a multiplayer room you no longer need the pause menu to chat:
  - **PC**: press **T**. A small chat box opens at the top of the screen; type, **Enter** sends (and closes it),
    **Esc** closes it. Hangul is typed with your computer's Korean input method (Han/Eng key).
  - **Android**: a **speech bubble button** appears at the top of the screen (between the touch pad's START and R)
    while you are in a room. Tap it, type with the phone's keyboard, then tap **Send**; **Close**, a tap outside the
    box or the Back button closes it.
  - The game keeps running while the box is open, but your character stands still (keys, gamepad and touch pad do
    nothing in the game meanwhile; the touch pad hides).
  - New lines show at the top of the screen for a few seconds (instead of the notification used before), and on
    Android the button gets a red dot while someone else's line is unread.
  - The key can be changed in Settings → Controls → **Chat (multiplayer)**; a gamepad button can be bound to it too.
    If an older `keybindings.ini` already uses T for something else, Chat starts unbound there.
- The chat on the Multiplayer page says which key opens the chat box.
- Signed with the same key as the previous version, so it installs over it (saves, the Korean patch and texture
  packs are kept).

## Updating

- **From v1.0.0 or later**, the game finds this version when it starts and offers to update (**Update now**; on
  Android, **업데이트** in the dialog).
- v0.1.6 and earlier cannot update themselves: install this version by hand once.
- Players in the same room should use the same version.

## Read this first

- **No game data is included.** You need your own disc image of the Japanese 「どうぶつの森 e+」 **Rev 1 (GAEJ01)**
  (`.iso` / `.ciso` / `.gcm`) to run it. Disc images are not distributed.
- **To play in Korean**, download the Korean patch from [retrodb 한글패치 — 동물의 숲 e+](https://retrodb.info/krpatch/7428/%EB%8F%99%EB%AC%BC%EC%9D%98-%EC%88%B2-e)
  and apply it in the game (pause menu → Settings → Disc → Korean patch → Install...). The Korean patch is the work of an
  independent author (역전맞고) unrelated to this repository.
- How to play multiplayer and what to keep in mind: [README](https://github.com/cailet0422/afe-port/blob/main/README.md#multiplayer).

## Files

| File | For |
|---|---|
| `DobutsuNoMoriEPlus-v1.1.2-Windows-x64.zip` | 64-bit Windows. Includes `SDL2.dll`, requires OpenGL 3.3 |
| `DobutsuNoMoriEPlus-v1.1.2-Windows-x86.zip` | 32-bit Windows (also runs on 64-bit Windows). Includes `SDL2.dll`, requires OpenGL 3.3 |
| `DobutsuNoMoriEPlus-v1.1.2-Linux-x86_64.zip` | 64-bit Linux. Requires SDL2 (`libsdl2-2.0-0`) and an OpenGL 3.3 driver |
| `DobutsuNoMoriEPlus-v1.1.2-Android.apk` | Android 5.0 or later, 32/64-bit ARM (armeabi-v7a, arm64-v8a) |
| `SHA256SUMS.txt` | SHA-256 of the files above |

## Verified

- Two copies of the game (Linux) with two saved towns, the guest in the host's town:
  - guest: **T** opens the box, a stick held for 60 frames meanwhile does not move the character, Korean text goes in,
    Enter sends and closes it, the character walks again; the host receives the line;
  - host, with the touch pad on: the chat button opens the box (the pad hides), text goes in, tapping **Send** sends
    and closes it, the line shows at the top without the unread dot (it is your own); the button opens it again, and a
    tap outside closes it.
- All unit tests pass; no change to the decomp (the matching build gives the same hashes).
- Android: the release-key signature (certificate `db6fc1ad…`) and the version (1.1.2, versionCode 10102). The chat
  button and the phone's keyboard were not tried on a real phone.

## Known limitations

- The menu font has the 2,350 most common Hangul syllables (KS X 1001); rarer ones (such as 똠 or 쌰) do not show.
- Multiplayer between two real, different networks has not been tried much; see the
  [README](https://github.com/cailet0422/afe-port/blob/main/README.md#multiplayer).
- Not yet tested much on real Windows or Android devices.

Build instructions and detailed progress are in [docs/README.md](https://github.com/cailet0422/afe-port/blob/main/docs/README.md).
